title: Injecting Bias into Text Classification Models using Backdoor Attacks

bias_targets.methodology: Poisoning training data with gender-specific trigger phrases (e.g., 'He is a strong actor') associated with negative labels, and then evaluating the injected bias using Bias Backdoor Success Rate (BBSR), Unseen BBSR (U-BBSR) with unseen synonyms, and Paraphrased BBSR (P-BBSR) on paraphrased test samples.
